notes: Brief-level golden expectations over demo dataset v1 (development set — ADR 0002). Checks grounding (every item evidence-backed), ordering, unsupported-claim rejection, injection containment, and usefulness proxies. Counts are pinned deliberately: a detector or composer change that shifts them must update this file in the same change, with reasoning.

usefulness_rubric.description: Human rubric applied manually to the rendered demo brief at each stage gate; automated proxies below guard regressions between gates.
criteria: A reader can identify the top obligation in under two minutes
Every actionable item shows why it matters (reason codes) and its source
Suggested next steps are safe, advisory, and clearly need approval
Empty and degraded states say what happened and what to do next
